title: Freya and the Extraction
author: Lior Vasquez
blurb: Casper Zhou, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
